                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତଗୁଡ଼ିକ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1. A = G → ମିଥ୍ୟା (A < U ≥ G. A ଏବଂ G ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଦୁଇଟି ବିପରୀତ ଚିହ୍ନ ଉପସ୍ଥିତ | ତେଣୁ, ", "or": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ଦିଆଯାଇଥିବା ବିବୃତ୍ତି: Z > M = A < U ≥ G ≥ L = D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତଗୁଡ଼ିକ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1. A = G → ମିଥ୍ୟା (A < U ≥ G. A ଏବଂ G ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଦୁଇଟି ବିପରୀତ ଚିହ୍ନ ଉପସ୍ଥିତ | ତେଣୁ, କୌଣସି ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧ ଗଠନ ହୋଇପାରିବ ନାହିଁ।)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2. G < D → ମିଥ୍ୟା (G ≥ L = D. ଏଥିରୁ, ଆମେ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ କରିପାରିବା ଯେ G ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ଭାବରେ D ଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ କିମ୍ବା ସମାନ।)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3. A > Z → ମିଥ୍ୟା (Z > M = A. ଏଥିରୁ, ଆମେ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଭାବରେ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ କରିପାରିବା ଯେ Z > A।)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                4. U > M → ସତ୍ୟ ( Z > M = A < U. ଏହା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଭାବରେ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ କରେ ଯେ U, A ଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ।)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ଏଠାରେ, ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ 4 ଅନୁସରଣ କରେ |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ଅତଏବ, ସଠିକ୍ ଉତ୍ତର ହେଉଛି \"ବିକଳ୍ପ 4\" |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1. A = G → ਗਲਤ (A < U ≥ G. A ਅਤੇ G ਦੇ ", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਕਥਨ: Z > M = A < U ≥ G ≥ L = D

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ਹੁਣ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                4. U > M → ਸਹੀ ( Z > M = A < U. ਇਹ ਸਪੱਸ਼ਟ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਸਿੱਟਾ ਕੱਢਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ U, A ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡਾ ਹੈ।)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ਇੱਥੇ, ਸਿੱਟਾ 4 ਲਾਗੂ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                கீழ்க்கண்டவற்றில் எது சமன்பாட்டின் வலது பக்கம் (RHS) ஆகும்

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ସମୀକରଣର RHS ଅଟେ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \\(\\sqrt {\\frac{{{\\rm{1 + sin}}\\,{\\rm{A}}}}{{{\\rm{1 - sin}}\\,{\\rm{A}}}}} =\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ਹੇਠ ਲਿਖਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਸਮੀਕਰਨ ਦਾ RHS ਹੈ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \\(\\sqrt {\\frac{{{\\rm{1 + sin}}\\,{\\rm{A}}}}{{{\\rm{1 - sin}}\\,{\\rm{A}}}}} =\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "sec A + tan A"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "\\(\\frac{{\\rm{1}}}{{{\\rm{cosec}}\\,{\\rm{A}}}}\\)"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "sec A + cot A"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "sin A + cos A"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Multiply the numerator and denominator inside the square root by the conjugate of the denominator, i.e., (1 + sin A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The expression becomes √[(1 + sin A)2 ÷ (1 − sin2 A)].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Since 1 − sin2 A = cos2 A, the square root simplifies to (1 + sin A) ÷ cos A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Separating the terms gives: 1 / cos A + sin A / cos A = sec A + tan A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ The correct answer is sec A + tan A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Expression: √[(1 + sin A) / (1 − sin A)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1 − sin2 A = cos2 A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1 / cos A = sec A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                sin A / cos A = tan A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ √[(1 + sin A) / (1 − sin A)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Rationalizing the denominator by multiplying the numerator and denominator by (1 + sin A):

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ √[((1 + sin A) × (1 + sin A)) / ((1 − sin A) × (1 + sin A))]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ √[(1 + sin A)2 / (1 − sin2 A)]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Using the identity 1 − sin2 A = cos2 A:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ √[(1 + sin A)2 / cos2 A]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Taking the square root of both numerator and denominator:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ (1 + sin A) / cos A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Dividing each term of the numerator by the denominator individually:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ (1 / cos A) + (sin A / cos A)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Applying the reciprocal and quotient identities:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ sec A + tan A

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ The correct answer is sec A + tan A.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Pythagorean Identities

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The fundamental relations in trigonometry are: sin2 A + cos2 A = 1, sec2 A − tan2 A = 1, and cosec2 A − cot2 A = 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Reciprocal Identities

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The reciprocal of cosine is secant (sec A = 1 / cos A) and the reciprocal of sine is cosecant (cosec A = 1 / sin A).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Rationalizing Trigonometric Expressions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Multiplying and dividing by a conjugate expression (such as 1 + sin A for 1 − sin A) is a standard technique to remove square roots by forming perfect squares and utilizing Pythagorean identities.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Shortcut Trick

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                वर्गमूल के अंदर अंश और हर को हर के संयुग्मी, यानी (1 + sin A) से गुणा करें।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                व्यंजक √[(1 + sin A)2 ÷ (1 − sin2 A)] बन जाता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                चूँकि 1 − sin2 A = cos2 A, वर्गमूल (1 + sin A) ÷ cos A में सरल हो जाता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                पदों को अलग करने पर मिलता है: 1 / cos A + sin A / cos A = sec A + tan A।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ सही उत्तर sec A + tan A है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                व्यंजक: &ra", "te": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఇచ్చినవి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                మనం సమీకరణం యొక్క RHSని కనుగొనాలి \\( \\sqrt{\\frac{1 + \\sin A}{1 - \\sin A}} \\).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఇచ్చిన సమీకరణాన్ని మార్చడానికి మనం త్రికోణమితి సర్వసమానతను ఉపయోగిస్తాము.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \\( \\sqrt{\\frac{1 + \\sin A}{1 - \\sin A}} = \\sec A + \\tan A \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
