                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a = 3a2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                b = 8ab

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                c = 4b2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                দ্বিঘাত সূত্র ব্যবহার করে:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                x = \\(\\dfrac{-8ab \\pm \\sqrt{(8ab)^2 - 4(3a^2)(4b^2)}}{2(3a^2)}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                x = \\(\\dfrac{-8ab \\pm \\sqrt{64a^2b^2 - 48a^2b^2}}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                x = \\(\\dfrac{-8ab \\pm \\sqrt{16a^2b^2}}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                x = \\(\\dfrac{-8ab \\pm 4ab}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                মূল:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1. \\(\\dfrac{-8ab + 4ab}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{-4ab}{6a^2} = \\dfrac{-2b}{3a}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2. \\(\\dfrac{-8ab - 4ab}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{-12ab}{6a^2} = \\dfrac{-2b}{a}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ মূলগুলি হল \\(\\dfrac{-2b}{3a}\\) এবং \\(\\dfrac{-2b}{a}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n2dd:T6a1,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                આપેલ છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                સમીકરણના મૂળ શોધો:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3a2x2 + 8abx + 4b2 = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલ સૂત્ર:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ax2 + bx + c = 0 સ્વરૂપમાં દ્વિઘાત સમીકરણના મૂળ આના દ્વારા આપવામાં આવે છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                આપેલ છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                સમીકરણના મૂળ શોધો:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3a2x2 + 8abx + 4b2 = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલ સૂત્ર:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ax2 + bx + c = 0 સ્વરૂપમાં દ્વિઘાત સમીકરણના મૂળ આના દ્વારા આપવામાં આવે છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \\(\\dfrac{-b \\pm \\sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ગણતરી:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                આપેલ સમીકરણ માટે, ax2 + bx + c = 0 સાથે સરખામણી કરો:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a = 3a2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                b = 8ab

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                c = 4b2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                દ્વિઘાત સૂત્રનો ઉપયોગ કરીને:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                x = \\(\\dfrac{-8ab \\pm \\sqrt{(8ab)^2 - 4(3a^2)(4b^2)}}{2(3a^2)}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                x = \\(\\dfrac{-8ab \\pm \\sqrt{64a^2b^2 - 48a^2b^2}}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                x = \\(\\dfrac{-8ab \\pm \\sqrt{16a^2b^2}}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                x = \\(\\dfrac{-8ab \\pm 4ab}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                મૂળ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1. \\(\\dfrac{-8ab + 4ab}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{-4ab}{6a^2} = \\dfrac{-2b}{3a}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2. \\(\\dfrac{-8ab - 4ab}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{-12ab}{6a^2} = \\dfrac{-2b}{a}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ મૂળ \\(\\dfrac{-2b}{3a}\\) અને \\(\\dfrac{-2b}{a}\\) છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n2de:T6b1,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಸಮೀಕರಣದ ಬೀಜಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಿರಿ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3a2x2 + 8abx + 4b2 = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಬಳಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ax2 + bx + c = 0 ರೂಪದ ವರ್ಗ ಸಮೀಕರಣದ ಬೀಜಗಳು:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \\(\\dfrac{-b \\pm \\sqrt{b^2 - 4", "kn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಸಮೀಕರಣದ ಬೀಜಗಳನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಿರಿ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3a2x2 + 8abx + 4b2 = 0

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಬಳಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ax2 + bx + c = 0 ರೂಪದ ವರ್ಗ ಸಮೀಕರಣದ ಬೀಜಗಳು:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \\(\\dfrac{-b \\pm \\sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ನೀಡಲಾದ ಸಮೀಕರಣವನ್ನು ax2 + bx + c = 0 ಜೊತೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a = 3a2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                b = 8ab

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                c = 4b2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ವರ್ಗ ಸೂತ್ರವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                x = \\(\\dfrac{-8ab \\pm \\sqrt{(8ab)^2 - 4(3a^2)(4b^2)}}{2(3a^2)}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                x = \\(\\dfrac{-8ab \\pm \\sqrt{64a^2b^2 - 48a^2b^2}}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                x = \\(\\dfrac{-8ab \\pm \\sqrt{16a^2b^2}}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                x = \\(\\dfrac{-8ab \\pm 4ab}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಬೀಜಗಳು:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                1. \\(\\dfrac{-8ab + 4ab}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{-4ab}{6a^2} = \\dfrac{-2b}{3a}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2. \\(\\dfrac{-8ab - 4ab}{6a^2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{-12ab}{6a^2} = \\dfrac{-2b}{a}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ ಬೀಜಗಳು \\(\\dfrac{-2b}{3a}\\) ಮತ್ತು \\(\\dfrac{-2b}{a}\\) ಆಗಿದೆ.
