                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t\t                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                		\n\t\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                90Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The table shows the production of different types of household items (in lakhs) by a certain company over the years.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Annual growth rate for an item from year Y1 to year Y2 is given by:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \\( \\text{Growth Rate} = \\frac{\\text{Production in Y}_2 - \\text{Production in Y}_1}{\\text{Production in Y}_1} \\times 100 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Calculating growth rates:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                For Item P:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2017: \\( \\frac{72 - 70}{70} \\times 100 = \\frac{2}{70} \\times 100 = 2.86\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2018: \\( \\frac{75 - 72}{72} \\times 100 = \\frac{3}{72} \\times 100 = 4.17\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2019: \\( \\frac{80 - 75}{75} \\times 100 = \\frac{5}{75} \\times 100 = 6.67\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2020: \\( \\frac{85 - 80}{80} \\times 100 = \\frac{5}{80} \\times 100 = 6.25\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2021: \\( \\frac{88 - 85}{85} \\times 100 = \\frac{3}{85} \\times 100 = 3.53\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                For Item Q:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2017: \\( \\frac{90 - 80}{80} \\times 100 = \\frac{10}{80} \\times 100 = 12.5\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2018: \\( \\frac{95 - 90}{90} \\times 100 = \\frac{5}{90} \\times 100 = 5.56\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2019: \\( \\frac{100 - 95}{95} \\times 100 = \\frac{5}{95} \\times 100 = 5.26\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2020: \\( \\frac{90 - 100}{100} \\times 100 = \\frac{-10}{100} \\times 100 = -10\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2021: \\( \\frac{110 - 90}{90} \\times 100 = \\frac{20}{90} \\times 100 = 22.22\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                For Item R:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2017: \\( \\frac{70 - 75}{75} \\times 100 = \\frac{-5}{75} \\times 100 = -6.67\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2018: \\( \\frac{80 - 70}{70} \\times 100 = \\frac{10}{70} \\times 100 = 14.29\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2019: \\( \\frac{90 - 80}{80} \\times 100 = \\frac{10}{80} \\times 100 = 12.5\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2020: \\( \\frac{95 - 90}{90} \\times 100 = \\frac{5}{90} \\times 100 = 5.56\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2021: \\( \\frac{100 - 95}{95} \\times 100 = \\frac{5}{95} \\times 100 = 5.26\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                For Item S:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2017: \\( \\frac{100 - 90}{90} \\times 100 = \\frac{10}{90} \\times 100 = 11.11\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2018: \\( \\frac{100 - 100}{100} \\times 100 = \\frac{0}{100} \\times 100 = 0\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2019: \\( \\frac{110 - 100}{100} \\times 100 = \\frac{10}{100} \\times 100 = 10\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2020: \\( \\frac{118 - 110}{110} \\times 100 = \\frac{8}{110} \\times 100 = 7.27\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2021: \\( \\frac{120 - 118}{118} \\times 100 = \\frac{2}{118} \\times 100 = 1.69\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                For Item T:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2017: \\( \\frac{52 - 50}{50} \\times 100 = \\frac{2}{50} \\times 100 = 4\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2018: \\( \\frac{58 - 52}{52} \\times 100 = \\frac{6}{52} \\times 100 = 11.54\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2019: \\( \\frac{60 - 58}{58} \\times 100 = \\frac{2}{58} \\times 100 = 3.45\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2020: \\( \\frac{64 - 60}{60} \\times 100 = \\frac{4}{60} \\times 100 = 6.67\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2021: \\( \\frac{70 - 64}{64} \\times 100 = \\frac{6}{64} \\times 100 = 9.38\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                For Item U:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2017: \\( \\frac{85 - 80}{80} \\times 100 = \\frac{5}{80} \\times 100 = 6.25\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2018: \\( \\frac{90 - 85}{85} \\times 100 = \\frac{5}{85} \\times 100 = 5.88\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2019: \\( \\frac{110 - 90}{90} \\times 100 = \\frac{20}{90} \\times 100 = 22.22\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2020: \\( \\frac{120 - 110}{110} \\times 100 = \\frac{10}{110} \\times 100 = 9.09\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2021: \\( \\frac{148 - 120}{120} \\times 100 = \\frac{28}{120} \\times 100 = 23.33\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ The correct answer is option 4, Items R in 2018 with a growth rate of 14.29%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                दिया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                तालिका एक निश्चित कंपनी द्वारा पिछले वर्षों में विभिन्न प्रकार की घरेलू वस्तुओं के उत्पादन (लाख में) को दर्शाती है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                वर्ष Y1 से वर्ष Y2 तक किसी वस्तु की वार्षिक वृद्धि दर निम्न प्रकार दी गई है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \\( \\text{Growth Rate} = \\frac{\\text{Production in Y}_2 - \\text{Production in Y}_1}{\\text{Production in Y}_1} \\times 100 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                वृद्धि दर की गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                वस्तु P के लिए:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2017: \\( \\frac{72 - 70}{70} \\times 100 = \\frac{2}{70} \\times 100 = 2.86\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2018: \\( \\frac{75 - 72}{72} \\times 100 = \\frac{3}{72} \\times 100 = 4.17\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2019: \\( \\frac{80 - 75}{75} \\times 100 = \\frac{5}{75} \\times 100 = 6.67\\% \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఇచ్చినవి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                పట్టిక ఒక నిర్దిష్ట కంపెనీ ద్వారా సంవత్సరాలుగా వివిధ రకాల గృహోపకరణాల ఉత్పత్తిని (లక్షలలో) చూపుతుంది.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Y1 సంవత్సరం నుండి Y2 సంవత్సరానికి ఒక వస్తువు యొక్క వార్షిక వృద్ధి రేటు దీని ద్వారా ఇవ్వబడుతుంది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \\( \\text{Growth Rate} = \\frac{\\text{Production in Y}_2 - \\text{Production in Y}_1}{\\text{Production in Y}_1} \\times 100 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
